name: Chevening Scholarship 2027/28
window: Sept 2027 – Sept 2028
family_note: Dependants allowed — government-funded scholars are exempt from the taught-master's dependant ban.
funding: Full tuition (no cap for MSc), £1,347+/month stipend, flights, visa, arrival allowance.
fit: UK government master's scholarship for future leaders; one-year taught master's at any UK university.
caveat: Needs two years' work experience and three university offers; essays are screened for AI-generated text.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters 2027
window: Consortium deadlines Oct 2026 – Jan 2027 (Jan is the busiest cluster); Sept 2027 start
family_note: Family reunion is hard because you move country each semester.
funding: €1,400/month for up to 24 months plus tuition and travel.
fit: Joint master's degrees taught across two or more European universities.
caveat: Each consortium sets its own deadline and documents; apply to up to three programmes.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
window: University application 16 Oct 2026 – 15 Jan 2027 (universityadmissions.se); SISGP scholarship form 8–24 Feb 2027; Aug 2027 start
family_note: Spouse can get a residence permit with work rights.
funding: Full tuition + SEK 12,000/month + one-time travel grant up to SEK 15,000 + insurance.
fit: Swedish master's scholarship for professionals from eligible countries with work and leadership experience.
caveat: Two steps: university application by mid-January, then the scholarship form in February.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
window: University internal deadlines Oct–Dec 2026 (e.g. Paris Cité master's 29 Oct–3 Nov; ENS Lyon 20 Nov); universities send files to Campus France by ~early Jan 2027; results from ~12 April 2027; Sept 2027 start
family_note: Family can visit on long-stay visitor visas at your own cost.
funding: Monthly allowance ~€1,200 for master's (Paris Cité figure for 2027) plus return flight, health insurance and cultural activities; no tuition cover (public French master's fees are low).
fit: French government excellence scholarship for master's and PhD students.
caveat: You cannot apply directly — a French university nominates you, and internal deadlines are earlier than Campus France's.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027
window: International round: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027 depending on your course funding deadline; Oct 2027 start
family_note: Taught MPhil students cannot bring dependants; research degrees can.
funding: Full: fees, £21,000+ stipend, flights, family allowance (only if dependants are permitted).
fit: Full-cost scholarship for any postgraduate course at the University of Cambridge.
caveat: Apply through the Cambridge course application by the funding deadline; leadership and commitment to others are scored.

name: KAUST MS (CS/AI) Fall 2027
window: Round 2 opens 28 Sept 2026; deadline 3 Jan 2027; decisions 14 Feb 2027; term starts 29 Aug 2027
family_note: Family housing on campus for married students.
funding: Full tuition, $20–30k/yr living allowance, housing, medical and dental, relocation.
fit: Fully funded MS/PhD in Saudi Arabia, including AI and computational sciences.
caveat: Strong research fit and references matter; programmes are research-heavy.

name: HBKU MS (Computer Science / Data Science)
window: Application opens 1 Oct 2026; international deadline 1 Feb 2027 (residents 15 Mar); Aug 2027 start
family_note: Family housing for married students is listed — confirm with the university.
funding: Tuition waiver, stipend and round-trip airfare for international scholars — but funding is competitive and not automatically guaranteed with admission.
fit: Master's and PhD programmes in Qatar, including computing and data science.
caveat: Scholarship support is competitive; confirm it in the offer letter.

name: Türkiye Bursları 2027
window: Window ~10 Jan – 20 Feb 2027 (closes around 20 Feb each year)
family_note: Family residence permit possible at your own cost.
funding: Tuition, housing, stipend, flights; they place you at a university.
fit: Turkish government scholarship covering degree programmes and a Turkish-language year.
caveat: Placement is decided by the scholarship body; you rank preferred universities.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28
window: Opens Nov 2026; closes ~15 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET (2026 cycle closed 15 Jan)
family_note: Stipend is small — not enough to support a family.
funding: Tuition, dormitory or housing contribution, small monthly stipend, insurance.
fit: Hungarian government scholarship for degree programmes, many taught in English.
caveat: Apply through your home country's sending partner as well as the portal.

name: Deep Learning Indaba 2027
family_note: One week — family can join as tourists.
funding: Travel grants common for African participants.
fit: Africa's largest machine-learning gathering: a week of talks, practicals and mentoring.
caveat: Selection is competitive; travel grants prioritise African participants.

name: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School — ML for Health track
window: ~July 2027
family_note: Short stay — visitor visa at your own cost.
funding: Fee-based with scholarships for lower-income-country applicants.
fit: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School with an ML-for-health track.
caveat: Fee-based, with scholarships for applicants from lower-income countries.

name: Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School 2027
window: ~July 2027
family_note: One week — family can join as tourists.
funding: Travel grants for eligible participants.
fit: Eastern European Machine Learning summer school: lectures plus hands-on labs.
caveat: Competitive; travel grants for eligible participants.

name: Machine Learning Summer School (MLSS) 2027
window: ~summer 2027
family_note: Two weeks — tourist basis.
funding: Modest fee; travel grants in most editions.
fit: Machine Learning Summer School — two weeks of advanced lectures; location changes yearly.
caveat: Check each edition's dates and fee.

name: UICC Technical Fellowships 2027
window: Call usually opens early April and closes early June (2026: 3 Apr – 4 Jun); visits later that year
family_note: Short visit — family would need their own visas.
funding: Grant covers travel and living costs of a short visit to a host cancer institution.
fit: Short funded visits for cancer professionals to learn a technique at a host institution.
caveat: Applications from UICC member institutions are prioritised; you need a host acceptance letter.

name: IARC Summer School 2027 (cancer epidemiology)
org: International Agency for Research on Cancer (WHO)
window: Runs every two years (2023, 2025); online phase then ~2 weeks in Lyon in June–July. 2025 call closed 6 Jan.
family_note: Short visit — family would need their own visas.
funding: €1,800 fee waived and costs covered by IARC scholarships for people working at institutions in low/middle-income countries.
fit: WHO cancer agency summer school in cancer epidemiology and prevention.
caveat: Runs every two years; check whether the next edition is confirmed.

name: EMBL-EBI: Data Science for Life Scientists 2027
window: Applications open 30 Nov 2026; course 14–18 June 2027, Hinxton (Cambridge)
family_note: Short visit.
funding: Fee £975 (academic) / £1,275 (industry); EBI sometimes offers bursaries — ask.
fit: Five-day hands-on course on machine learning and LLMs for biological data.
caveat: Paid course with few places; ask about bursaries.

name: WHX Dubai 2027 (formerly Arab Health)
window: 25–28 Jan 2027, Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City
family_note: Easy tourist visa; family can come.
funding: Visitor registration (exhibition passes usually free or low-cost if booked early; conference tracks paid). Flights + hotel self-funded.
fit: The region's largest health-technology expo — vendors, hospital groups and recruiters.
caveat: An expo, not training — plan meetings in advance.

name: ISTA year-round scientific internship (predoc) — salaried, 2–12 months
org: Institute of Science and Technology Austria — predoc@ista.ac.at
window: Rolling; register in the portal at least 2 months before your start date
family_note: Possible on a work contract, but the salary is tight for two.
funding: Employment contract with ISTA at a minimum of €1,583 gross per month plus social insurance; no fees. You may not be employed or funded elsewhere during the internship.
fit: Salaried research internship at the Institute of Science and Technology Austria.
caveat: You need a lab to agree to host you before applying.

name: DSSGx Munich 2027 — Data Science for Social Good
window: 2026 call closed 24 Apr; fellowship ran 3 Aug – 2 Oct
family_note: Short stay — no dependant route.
funding: ~€1,500/month stipend; travel and visa not covered.
fit: Two-month team data-science fellowship on social-good projects in Munich.
caveat: Stipend barely covers living costs; you arrange your own visa.

name: Pivotal Research Fellowship, Jan 2027 cohort
window: Apply by 1 Nov 2026 23:59 AoE; fellowship 18 Jan – 30 Apr 2027 in London (LISA)
family_note: Short stay — family can visit on visitor visas.
funding: £15–18k stipend + £1,800/month housing; food, compute and travel covered.
fit: Paid AI-safety research fellowship in London with mentors.
caveat: Very competitive; strongest applications match one mentor's project.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships 2028
window: Opens 1 Feb 2027; 2028 start
family_note: Dependants may accompany on your visa (not funded).
funding: Full tuition, living stipend, flights, insurance.
fit: Australian government scholarships for degree study, for eligible countries.
caveat: Eligibility and priority fields vary by country; check your country profile.

name: MEXT Scholarship (embassy recommendation) 2028
window: Apr or Oct 2028 start
family_note: Dependant visa possible; stipend is tight for two.
funding: Tuition, ¥144,000+/month, flights.
fit: Japanese government scholarship for graduate study via embassy or university recommendation.
caveat: Long process with exams and interviews; start a year ahead.
